_: EXPERIENCE GATE — INSTRUMENT LIMITS. Records the player-experience harness (test/wg-experience.harness.test.tsx + scripts/wg-experience.mjs) cannot observe correctly, each VERIFIED BY HAND against the running builder by the Opus triage reader and its adversarial refuter (2026-09-02): the control exists on the class chassis and cannot be switched off by removing the feature, the bonus lives in play state the host never enters, WG's variable is bookkeeping with no sheet value, or the host cannot satisfy a prose prerequisite. The gate PARKS these in the EXPERIENCE gate only and PRINTS them on every run. This is NOT a place for defects: a real gap is fixed or goes to work/owner-questions.json. Remove an entry the moment the instrument can see the record (the gate then judges it again).

The batch-030 row is feats/cantrip-supremacy spellSlotBonus {entryId:'hedge-mage-dedication-casting', cantrips:10} — deliberately the ARCHETYPE entry id, so cantripBonusFor (build.ts:2225) skips it and the CLASS cantrip cap is untouched, which is what print says. The harness played it on a level-20 fighter with no Hedge Mage Dedication: our record's prerequisites array is empty and it carries no `archetype` field (123 of our 130 category:'archetype' feats carry none), so neither withPrerequisiteFeats' prerequisite walk nor its archetype fallback had a name to place, and the host has no keepsake entry for the 10 cantrips to land on. WG's two giveSpellSlot ops deliver nothing on that host either. The row itself is pinned by test/batch030-data.test.ts, describe('cantrip-supremacy gives the Hedge Mage keepsake 10 more cantrips').

unshaken-in-iron.verified: WG's unchecked op is adjValue ARMOR_SPECIALIZATION_LIGHT = true. Our carrier is the record's own armorSpec {categories:['light'], ifTrained:['medium','heavy'], bonusWhileStance:{stanceId:'tenacious-stance', source:'armorCheckPenalty'}} — an armour-specialization ACCESS grant, and the exact twin of their variable. Its reader is gated on WORN ARMOUR: derive.ts:2718 calls armorSpecAccess(c, db) inside the `worn` branch and only then computes armorSpecValue(worn.armor.group, ...), so a character wearing nothing gets no value to move — the same blind spot as unburdened-iron (batch 6), whose lane this is. The harness host is a level-20 fighter with an empty inventory, so the differential moved 0 values and the sheet snapshot carries no armour-specialization surface for the harness to read. Delivery is pinned on a built, ARMOURED character instead: test/armor-specialization.test.ts:98-101 reads db.feats['unshaken-in-iron'].armorSpec.categories === ['light'] and applies it to a level-20 champion carrying the feat, and test/batch030-gap-stance-toggle.test.tsx pins the bonusWhileStance half by putting a Tenacious Stance chip on a built Stalwart Defender. wg-diff's own kind teach for the same carrier is pinned mutation-proof at test/batch030-instruments.test.ts:101.

creed-magic.verified: The harness played a CLASS-ARCHETYPE feat on the wrong class. AoN feat-7510 prints 'You gain two special 2nd-rank creed spell slots... At 10th level, the extra slots increase to 3rd rank... At 14th level, the extra slots increase to 4th rank', and ours is feats/creed-magic spellSlotBonus {entryId:'cleric-casting', restricted:{label:'Creed slots', ladder:[{level:8,byRank:{2:2}},{level:10,byRank:{3:2}},{level:14,byRank:{4:2}}]}}, resolved by resolveRestrictedSlots (src/rules/restrictedSlots.ts) with the ladder REPLACING rather than accumulating - the printed 'increase to' reading. featHost (test/wg-experience.harness.test.tsx:400-407) picks the host class from the feat's TRAITS, and creed-magic's traits are only ['archetype'], so the host was a level-20 FIGHTER (work/wg-batch-031-experience.json records ours.host.classId 'fighter', prerequisites ['battle-harbinger-dedication']). An entryId-scoped spellSlotBonus resolves through slotEntryFor (build.ts:6893) as spellcasting.find(e => e.id === bonus.entryId) followed by `if (!entry) continue`, so on a fighter there is no 'cleric-casting' entry and the two creed slots are silently dropped - sheetDiffCount 0. feats/battle-harbinger-dedication carries classArchetype.classId 'cleric', so the owner of this archetype is ALWAYS a cleric and 'cleric-casting' is the right entry id. Delivery is pinned on a cleric instead: test/restricted-slots.test.ts, describe('Creed Magic - two slots that MOVE rank, and a list that grows'), builds a cleric at 8/9/10/13/14/20 and asserts exactly two restricted slots on cleric-casting at rank 2/3/4 with the allowed list growing 4 -> 6 -> 8 (unfettered-movement at 14) and none at all without the feat; 15/15 green. test/batch031-instruments.test.ts, describe('batch 031 instruments - creed-magic is hosted on the wrong class (feats/creed-magic)'), pins the CAUSE: the same feat on a cleric host delivers the slots and on a fighter host delivers nothing, and a copy with spellSlotBonus stripped delivers nothing on the cleric either. CROSS-FILE: the durable fix is featHost preferring the classArchetype.classId of the archetype's dedication - reported, not made, because the harness file is outside this family's assignment.

the-distant-grasp.verified: ONE undelivered giveSpell survives the batch-33 qualifier teach, and it is a LEGACY PRINTING on their side. The AoN mirror holds TWO 'The Distant Grasp' documents: conscious-mind-1 (legacy) prints '**3rd** [Levitate]' and conscious-mind-7 (the remaster reprint) prints '**3rd** [Gravity Well]'. WG's giveSpell names Levitate; our carrier is classes.psychic.extraChoices[featureId 'conscious-mind'].options['the-distant-grasp'], whose description prints '3rd: Gravity Well' and whose grantedSpells carry gravity-well. Print (the remaster document) wins, so the divergence is deliberate and adopting theirs would move us AWAY from print. The other thirteen ops now deliver: the two '(Psi)' names (Telekinetic Hand (Psi), Telekinetic Projectile (Psi)) are matched by the anchored qualifier strip added to effectDelivery's giveSpell branch in scripts/lib/wg-experience-lanes.mjs this batch, because print calls those cantrips and we place them as the base cantrip in the occult repertoire (build.ts ~4892, pool seeded from psi-cantrips-and-amps.focusPoolBonus). The strip is anchored to (Psi)|(legacy) rather than to any parenthetical precisely so a '(deprecated)' (30 in the dump) or '(playtest)' (170) name can never be laundered into the base spell; pinned by test/wg-experience-lanes.test.ts, describe('batch 33 ...'), it('the-distant-grasp / the-tangible-dream: (Psi) and (legacy) strip, (deprecated) and (playtest) do NOT'), which also stunts spellNames to [] and asserts undelivered returns.
the-distant-grasp.refuter: The two sibling records the same teach was written for, the-unbound-step and the-tangible-dream, clear OUTRIGHT and are deliberately NOT parked here - only the record with a genuine print divergence keeps an entry. The five granted-ACTION records the builder had specified for this file (way-of-the-drifter, way-of-the-sniper, way-of-the-vanguard, interrogation-methodology, alchemical-sciences-methodology) are also NOT parked: the surface now carries actionNames (test/wg-experience.harness.test.tsx surfaceOf, from Character.grantedActionIds) and the harness sees the action it always delivered.

battle-creed.verified: WG raises two `select from:ADJ_VALUE "Select Deity Weapon"` ops, and PRINT OFFERS NO CHOICE: Lesser Creed (5th) 'You gain expert proficiency with your deity's favored weapon, martial weapons, simple weapons, and unarmed attacks', Major Creed (13th) 'You gain master proficiency with your deity's favored weapon'. The weapon is DERIVED from the deity already chosen, not picked: build.ts:3784 computes favoredWeaponRank for clericDoctrine === 'battle-creed' as master at 13, expert at 5, trained below, and build.ts:3817 writes it as a per-weapon override over every entry of the chosen deity's favoredWeapons. Their select is their own workaround for not resolving the deity's favored weapon; no visible control is owed here, so the MISSING-CONTROL verdict is an instrument artefact and not a parity gap. The value half of this record is already closed and mutation-proofed in test/batch033-instruments.test.ts (the advancement table keyed 'battle-creed').
battle-creed.refuter: Checked the only way this could be a real gap: if a deity had MORE THAN ONE favored weapon the player would owe a pick. Build.ts:3817 loops every id in deity.favoredWeapons and grants the rank to each, so even a multi-weapon deity needs no choice from the player - there is nothing to select. No control is hidden; there is none to render.

armor-innovation.verified: Print: 'Choose one of the sets of statistics on Innovation Armor Statistics table for your innovation armor'. The control EXISTS and the player sees it - src/builder/shared.tsx:3567-3577 renders a PopupSelect titled 'Armor base statistics' inside the 'Armor base' SubCard with exactly the two printed options (Power Suit, Subterfuge Suit), writing build.inventorArmorStats. Its answer is load-bearing downstream: shared.tsx:3559 feeds it to inventorModificationOptions so an unpicked suit offers only the non-exclusive modifications, build.ts:8389 reads it when resolving the innovation's statistics, build.ts:7691 puts the chosen suit in the inventory, and build.ts:1262 lists 'Armor base' as an OUTSTANDING REQUIRED CHOICE until it is answered. The harness only observes controls the RECORD's own differential adds, and this picker is keyed on the innovation type in the builder rather than on classFeatures/armor-innovation, so it is invisible to the instrument - not absent from the app. Paired with the OFF_RECORD_OPTIONS entry for 'armor-innovation' in scripts/wg-identity.mjs, whose precedent is 'path-to-perfection' (the same shape: a picker whose whole state is a BuildState field).
armor-innovation.refuter: Tried to break it by asking whether the control is merely cosmetic: it is not. Remove the answer and build.ts:1262 reports the character as having an unanswered required choice, and inventorModificationOptions changes what the next picker offers - the pick has consequences on the sheet, so a player who never sees it is blocked, which is the opposite of what a parked MISSING-CONTROL would hide. The record's separate `items` half (armor-innovation#suit-item) is NOT covered by this entry and is still reported by wg-identity.

the-infinite-eye.verified: EXACTLY THE SHAPE ALREADY PARKED FOR the-distant-grasp (batch 33), one conscious-mind option over. WG encodes 14 value-bearing ops on this row; 13 deliver and the fourteenth is 'giveSpell "Organsight"' inside 'IF LEVEL >= 3', which is a PRE-REMASTER PRINTING on their side. The AoN mirror holds two 'The Infinite Eye' documents: conscious-mind-2 (Dark Archive, legacy) prints '- 3rd Organsight' and conscious-mind-8 (Dark Archives Remastered) prints '- 3rd Locate'. Our record IS the remaster one - edition 'remaster', aonId conscious-mind-8 - and its carrier classes.psychic.subclass.options['the-infinite-eye'].grantedSpells holds locate, so the 3rd-rank slot is filled with the spell PRINT gives it. Adopting theirs would move us away from print, which is the definition of a false positive rather than a gap. Adversarially confirmed against the dump rather than against the finding's own citation: resolving WG's 14 spellIds against public.spell shows the 3rd-rank op is spellId 5410 = Organsight (the finding's 'theirs' field names 4406, which is Augury - a citation nit that does not touch the substance) and the other 13 match our grantedSpells one for one. The batch-33 '(Psi)'/'(legacy)' qualifier strip in effectDelivery cannot reach this one: their name is the bare word 'Organsight', with no qualifier to strip, and widening the strip to any spell we do not carry would launder every genuinely undelivered giveSpell in the corpus - so this is parked per record, not taught.
the-infinite-eye.refuter: Tried to break it two ways. (1) Is Locate really OUR 3rd-rank grant, or is the slot empty and Organsight simply missing from both sides? grantedSpells on the subclass option carries 'locate' explicitly, so the slot is filled. the-oscillating-wave.verified: THE SAME LANE AS the-distant-grasp (batch 33) AND the-infinite-eye (batch 34), one conscious-mind option over, but a whole LIST rather than one name. WG encodes 15 value-bearing ops; 10 deliver and the five that do not are 'giveAbilityBlock "Conservation of Energy"' (NOT covered here - see the refuter) plus four giveSpells: Heat Metal, Fire Shield, 'Flame Vortex (legacy)' and Fiery Body. Those four are the LEGACY printing's granted-spell ladder. The AoN mirror holds two 'The Oscillating Wave' documents and each names the other: conscious-mind-3 (Dark Archive, remaster_id ['conscious-mind-9']) prints 'Granted Spells - 1st Burning Hands - 2nd Heat Metal - 3rd Fireball - 4th Fire Shield - 5th Cone of Cold - 6th Flame Vortex - 7th Fiery Body - 8th Polar Ray - 9th Meteor Swarm', while conscious-mind-9 (Dark Archives (Remastered)) prints 'Granted Spells - 1st Breathe Fire - 2nd Blazing Bolt - 3rd Fireball - 4th Ice Storm - 5th Howling Blizzard - 6th Frozen Fog - 7th Volcanic Eruption - 8th Arctic Rift - 9th Falling Stars'. Our record IS the remaster one - classFeatures['the-oscillating-wave'] edition 'remaster', aonId conscious-mind-9, source 'Pathfinder Dark Archive (Remastered)' - and its carrier classes.psychic.subclass.options['the-oscillating-wave'].grantedSpells holds exactly those nine plus frostbite, ignition, thermal-stasis, entropic-wheel and redistribute-potential, with classFeatures['conscious-mind'].grantedSpells['the-oscillating-wave'] carrying the [{entropic-wheel,6},{redistribute-potential,10}] ladder. Adopting theirs would move us AWAY from print, which is a false positive and not a gap. THEIR ROW IS A HYBRID, which is what makes this look like a delivery gap rather than an edition difference: the four legacy rungs whose spell was merely RENAMED in the remaster (Burning Hands to Breathe Fire, Cone of Cold to Howling Blizzard, Polar Ray to Arctic Rift, Meteor Swarm to Falling Stars) picked the new name up and DO deliver against our list, while the four rungs whose spell was REPLACED outright still name the legacy spell and cannot. The batch-33 '(Psi)'/'(legacy)' qualifier strip in effectDelivery reaches only the parenthetical on 'Flame Vortex (legacy)' and there is no flame-vortex on our ladder behind it, so widening the strip would launder every genuinely undelivered giveSpell in the corpus - parked per record, not taught. Adversarially confirmed against the mirror and against public/core.json rather than against the finding's own prose: the finding claims the ladder matches 'rung for rung' and it does not - four rungs differ, and the reason they differ is the printing, which is the substance the park rests on.
the-oscillating-wave.refuter: Tried to break it three ways. (1) Is our 2nd/4th/6th/7th ladder actually FILLED, or empty with the legacy spells simply missing from both sides? grantedSpells carries blazing-bolt, ice-storm, frozen-fog and volcanic-eruption explicitly - the remaster rungs are filled, so nothing is absent from the player. wandering-reverie.verified: The same host blindness the five animist apparitions above are parked for, on the psychic instead. classFeatureHost (test/wg-experience.harness.test.tsx:494-509) resolves an owner through ownedAt20(db, classId, null) and db.classes[classId].subclass?.options only; psychic's subclass group is Conscious Mind, while Subconscious Mind is classes.psychic.extraChoices[0] - so no owner is ever found and the harness returns supported:false with reason 'no class or subclass grants this feature at level 20'. WG's four ops all land on our side: setValue CLASS_DC {value T, attribute ATTRIBUTE_CHA}, adjValue ATTRIBUTE_CHA +1 and defineCastingSource PSYCHIC:::SPONTANEOUS-REPERTOIRE:::OCCULT:::ATTRIBUTE_CHA are three readings of ONE field, extraChoices['subconscious-mind'].options['wandering-reverie'].keyAbility = 'cha', walked by subclassKeyAbility (src/rules/build.ts:889-904) for the level-1 key-attribute boost (:1327), by choiceKeyAbility (:3377) for the class DC (:3393) and by the spellcasting entry (:4260, :4477); and giveAbilityBlock 'Fade into Daydreams' is classFeatures['wandering-reverie'].grantsClassFeatures ['fade-into-daydreams'], resolved at derive.ts:3532 because grantOptions become classChoices (build.ts:5296) and so reach classFeatureIdsOwned (derive.ts:3389). Adversarially confirmed on a really built level-20 psychic rather than from the finding's prose: test/batch035-instruments-1.test.ts builds the class with extraChoices['subconscious-mind'] = ['wandering-reverie'] and asserts character.keyAbility is 'cha' (and 'int' for the gathered-lore sibling), which is exactly the op the UNSUPPORTED verdict claims was never seen.
wandering-reverie.refuter: Tried to break it two ways. (1) Is the option's keyAbility a dead field, so the park would be excusing an empty record? No - build the psychic with the pick and character.keyAbility moves; classes.psychic.keyAbility is [] on purpose precisely because the subconscious mind answers it. (2) Does the park hide anything the gate was catching? No, and this is the honest half: the gate short-circuits UNSUPPORTED before it ever consults this file (scripts/wg-batch-gate.mjs:527 pushes it to `unsupported` and continues), so the entry changes no verdict - it is the family's ledger of WHY the harness is blind, kept beside the five apparitions in the same lane so the route is recorded once.
